name: 40511 · Lexington, KY
findings: ZIP 40511 (Lexington) has 178 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40511 (Lexington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40511 (Lexington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
